title: Test that a Claude background-end registration whose run directory is a link or junction escaping the run root is refused before any read
outcome: A behaviour test pins the background-end guard: a registration whose run directory resolves outside run root/run_id is refused and attaches nothing, and no file under the escaped target is read.
acceptance: Test that a Claude background-end registration whose run directory is a link or junction escaping the run root is refused before any read is done
